mapper.insert: insert into pep_domain.device_channel (device_id, channel_no, channel_type, name, enabled, metadata, created_at, updated_at) values (#{deviceId}, #{channelNo}, #{channelType}, #{name}, #{enabled}, cast(#{metadata} as jsonb), #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
